hook: AI gave me a 7-step plan when I needed a 7-word answer.
caption:
AI gave me a 7-step plan when I needed a 7-word answer.

You asked: "Should I take this freelance project?"

AI answered with a 400-word pros/cons matrix, a section on "evaluating your long-term career trajectory," and a reminder to "consult a financial advisor."

You already knew the answer. You just needed someone to confirm it in one sentence.

This is the thing nobody talks about: AI doesn't know if you're a person who wants to be walked through every option — or someone who's already done the thinking and just needs a gut-check.

One type of person reads that 400-word response and feels helped.

The other type closes the tab and texts a friend.

Neither person is wrong. But the AI treated you both the same.

Your BootFile fixes this. It tells AI whether you process by exploring or by deciding. Whether you want the reasoning shown or just the conclusion. Whether "be concise" means 3 sentences or 3 bullet points.

Same question. Completely different answer. Both actually useful.

Stop training AI from scratch every single conversation. 👇 Link in bio.
